This is on a length outside off and Kohli looks to go inside out. Skies it in the end and Rana holds on to the catch. That came off the sticker of the bat! First time that Archer gets Kohli in T20s!. 156/2Fazalhaq Farooqi3030010.00310Tushar Deshpande2036018.00220Sandeep Sharma4045211.2564016.1 to D Padikkal, Spooned to mid-off and Rana holds on after a juggling act! This is a slower ball and Padikkal looks to power this down the ground. Can't get power or elevation behind that and it goes to Rana who was backtracking to adjust and it pops out of his hands as he is falling back and he pops out one hand and it pops out again before he falls forward and holds it between his hands and body. 161/316.5 to RM Patidar, Edged and taken! Back of length outside off, cross-seam, Patidar slashes at it and Jurel does the rest as the ball kisses the outside edge. 163/4PhotosWanindu Hasaranga403017.504106.4 to PD Salt, skied to deep midwicket and Salt has run out of luck! Pitched up without much pace and swept against the turn for a leading edge that sends the ball into the night sky before it lands in Hetmyer's hands well inside the rope. 61/1PhotosRiyan Parag3030010.00500Rajasthan Royals (T: 206 runs from 20 ovs)Batting RBM4s6sSRYashasvi Jaiswal c Shepherd b Hazlewood49192873257.89Vaibhav Sooryavanshi b Kumar16122002133.33Nitish Rana c Kumar b Pandya28224731127.27Riyan Parag (c)c †Sharma b Pandya22101922220.00Dhruv Jurel †c †Sharma b Hazlewood47344533138.23Shimron Hetmyer c †Sharma b Hazlewood1181410137.50Shubham Dubey c Salt b Yash Dayal1271811171.42Jofra Archer c Patidar b Hazlewood011000.00Wanindu Hasaranga run out (David/†Sharma)1360033.33Tushar Deshpande not out 1250050.00Fazalhaq Farooqi not out 22100100.00Extras(b 1, w 4)5Total20 Ov (RR: 9.70)194/9Fall of wickets DRS1-52 (Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 4.2 ov), 2-72 (Yashasvi Jaiswal, 5.5 ov), 3-110 (Riyan Parag, 9.1 ov), 4-134 (Nitish Rana, 13.3 ov), 5-162 (Shimron Hetmyer, 16.3 ov), 6-189 (Dhruv Jurel, 18.3 ov), 7-189 (Jofra Archer, 18.4 ov), 8-189 (Shubham Dubey, 19.1 ov), 9-191 (Wanindu Hasaranga, 19.3 ov)BowlingOMRWECON0sWDNBBhuvneshwar Kumar4050112.5011004.2 to V Sooryavanshi, middle stump gone and the crowd is awake! Not a short ball for a change, it's on length towards the stumps and the teenager swings wildly and misses. 52/1Yash Dayal3033111.0051019.1 to SB Dubey, Full toss and he hits it straight to deep midwicket! Low full toss just outside off and Shubham Dubey picks out Phil Salt. The crowd is going crazy as RCB close in on their first home win of the season!. 189/8PhotosJosh Hazlewood403348.2515105.5 to YBK Jaiswal, and Hazlewood has avenged himself, he'll think. He gets the reward of persisting with the short length, this one climbs on Jaiswal for the pull which he doesn't middle this time and hands a simple catch to the midwicket fielder coming in. 72/216.3 to SO Hetmyer, Has he nicked that? The umpire reckons he has! Beautiful from Hazlewood! It's back of length around leg, cramping Hetmyer, who plays all around it, trying to whip it leg side. Gets an inside edge and Hazlewood has done it again for RCB!. 162/518.3 to DC Jurel, Jurel backs away to make room and Hazlewood nails the wide yorker! The ball sneaks past as Jurel brings his bat down. And hold on, RCB have reviewed for caught-behind! Was there a thin bottom edge as Jurel brought the bat down? There is a spike as the ball crosses bat! They will do a check now for a bump ball. No, no bounce, Jurel is gone three short of a fifty! Hazlewood has got a third! What an appeal from Jitesh Sharma there! Jitesh has been excellent with his judgement behind the stumps this season, when it's come to reviews.. 189/618.4 to JC Archer, Two in two for Hazlewood! Back of length outside off, Archer looks to go inside out and there's no foot movement and he ends up slicing it up to cover's left. Patidar makes no mistake and Archer is disgusted with himself! RCB right back in this! What twists and turns over the last two-three overs!. 189/7Romario Shepherd1015015.00200Suyash Sharma403107.75800Krunal Pandya403127.758109.1 to R Parag, he strikes first ball and we do have a crowd here at the Chinnaswamy! Big sweep against the turn first ball, goes up a mile close to the pitch and Jitesh, with his gloves, under the helmet, moves towards short midwicket and pouches it. Krunal has his finger up but no send off or word spoken. 110/313.3 to N Rana, Rana picks out short fine leg! Krunal bowls this on a length on leg, Rana looks for the sweep but hits this straight to Bhuvneshwar. Was above his head height and he puts up his hands to grab it. Ends up parrying it in the air and takes it at the second go. The pressure tells! The new ball also helps RCB!. 134/4PhotosUnlocking the magic of StatsguruRoyal Challengers Bengaluru inningsPowerplay 1: Overs 0.1 - 6.0 (Mandatory - 59 runs, 0 wicket)Royal Challengers Bengaluru Impact Player Subs: Suyash Sharma, Rasikh Salam, Manoj Bhandage, Jacob Bethell, Swapnil SinghRajasthan Royals Impact Player Subs: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Yudhvir Singh, Kumar Kartikeya, Akash Madhwal, Kunal Singh RathoreRoyal Challengers Bengaluru: 50 runs in 4.4 overs (28 balls), Extras 71st Wicket: 50 runs in 28 balls (PD Salt 23, V Kohli 20, Ex 7)Strategic Timeout: Royal Challengers Bengaluru -
